title: Everyone
description: Everyday tools: read text or QR codes from a picture, shrink for sending, remove location data, unzip.

actions.label: Text
actions.description: Read the text in the image and copy it
actions.command: open "flickwheel://tool?name=ocr&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"

actions.label: Send-ready
actions.description: Shrink to 1600 px and drop EXIF/GPS, ready to send
actions.command: open "flickwheel://tool?name=send&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"

actions.label: Clean
actions.description: Copy without EXIF, GPS or camera data
actions.command: open "flickwheel://tool?name=strip&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"

actions.label: Unzip
actions.description: Extract into a folder next to the zip

actions.label: QR
actions.description: Read a QR code or barcode in the image and copy its text
actions.command: open "flickwheel://tool?name=qr&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"
